# Exasol Personal

> Exasol Personal runs a full Exasol analytics database locally or in your own cloud account,
> managed by the `exasol` command-line launcher.

## AI agents

- [Connect an AI agent](ai-agents/): enable the Exasol MCP server on a local deployment with
  `exasol mcp enable` and show client setup instructions with `exasol mcp instructions <client>`.

## Documentation

- [Exasol Personal documentation](./): installation, deployment, and database usage.
- [CLI reference](cli-reference/): every launcher command and option.
